description: This file defines an interface 'AuthTokenHelper' that provides methods for creating and parsing JSON Web Tokens (JWTs) used for user authentication and authorization. It includes methods to get token lifetime, create tokens with user identity and authorities, and expand (parse) encoded tokens.

classes.name: AuthTokenHelper
classes.description: An interface providing methods for creating and parsing JWT tokens related to user authentication and authorities.

methods.name: getTokenLifetime
methods.description: Returns the duration used for the 'exp' claim of tokens, indicating their expiry time.

methods.name: createToken
methods.description: Creates a JWT token containing the user's identity and authorities, with an expiration based on the token lifetime.

methods.name: expand
methods.description: Expands (parses) an encoded JWT token, verifying its signature and extracting claims. Throws JwtException if invalid.
